question_text: How many person_entry events were recorded at KeynoteHall_DoorA on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?

gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM events WHERE event_type = 'person_entry' AND camera_location = 'KeynoteHall_DoorA' AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'

metadata.note: Keynote hall entry with peak attendance hours.
